facts.fact: ENDA Sante says Senegal's health ministry is carrying a draft digital health framework law and implementing decree that cover hosting of data on the national territory.
facts.system: projet de loi d'orientation sur la sante numerique

facts.fact: ENDA Sante says Senegal's draft personal data law would give more power and responsibility to the existing Commission de Protection des Donnees Personnelles.
facts.system: Commission de Protection des Donnees Personnelles

systems.system: Commission de Protection des Donnees Personnelles

facts.fact: ENDA Sante says Senegal's digital ministry has proposed since 2017 a draft personal data protection law to strengthen the existing 2008 legislation.
The same article says the draft would give more power and responsibility to the existing Commission de Protection des Donnees Personnelles.
facts.system: Commission de Protection des Donnees Personnelles

SEN.note: A draft health law covers data hosting and sovereignty for patient data; no rule on government data in general is stated.
Consultation was in person at Dakar; no online channel stated.
A draft law would institutionalise a single patient record; no HMIS or EMR in service stated.
The 29 April 2024 consultation was run by ENDA Sante and Transform Health, NGOs; no government call for views stated.
No African legal text signed, ratified or given effect stated.
